title: [Preview] bc2adls and Fabric Open Mirroring
summary: BC2ADLS now supports Microsoft Fabric's Open Mirroring feature, allowing Business Central data to be exported to a Fabric Landing Zone in CSV or Parquet format without requiring manual notebook processing. Fabric automatically handles change data capture and replication, enabling faster data access from Business Central to Fabric.
key_points: Open Mirroring requires a _metadata.json file describing the table schema with key columns and column data types
CSV files are now supported alongside Parquet format in Open Mirroring
The __rowMarker__ column indicates operation type: 0 for inserts, 1 for updates, 2 for deletes
File names must be in 20-digit continuous number format; resetting a table resets the number sequence
BC2ADLS v26.32 adds Open Mirroring support, currently in preview

quotes.text: So no need for running a notebook anymore. Fabric will do the CDC processing for you.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the key benefit of Open Mirroring - automatic data processing without manual intervention

quotes.text: The benefit is then that you can use the data faster!
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the performance advantage of using Open Mirroring over manual notebook processing

quotes.text: Please mention that this feature is still in preview in bc2adls but also in Microsoft Fabric!
quotes.why_it_matters: Important caveat about the maturity level of both the feature and the tool
